launch_product_resources.scope: Management product-cost boundary excludes corporate SG&A/R&D; neither complete company cash nor a field-qualified cost estimate.

other_gross_financing_components.label: Gross headline less already-received component
other_gross_financing_components.scope: Arithmetic of approximate headline components before expenses; not net new cash or available cash balance.

ownership_five_year_payments.label: Displayed ownership payment components
ownership_five_year_payments.scope: Same hypothetical life; these payments do not identify an executed customer contract or whole-system cost.

raas_five_year_payments.formula: monthly subscription × 12 × assumed life + deployment fee
raas_five_year_payments.label: Displayed RaaS payment components
raas_five_year_payments.scope: Undiscounted arithmetic of rounded planning amounts; excludes customer retained work, financing and all other unpriced costs.

commercial_disclosures.population_guard: No ratio combines site totes and multi-program fleet hours.
commercial_disclosures.rounding_boundary: Exact component arithmetic can differ from approximate slide headlines; this is not a correction of undisclosed internal modeling.
commercial_disclosures.source_boundary: Source assumptions and historical disclosures remain separate from synthetic model parameters.

customer_payback.reason: No dated investment and avoidable cash flow.

customer_roi.reason: No executed price and complete matched cash schedule.

net_new_closing_cash.reason: Rounded gross aggregate includes prior funding and excludes expenses; post-close reconciliation absent.

paid_labor_removed.reason: No matched schedules or payroll change.

provider_runway.reason: Post-close unrestricted cash and future spending schedule are not established.

site_accepted_output_rate.reason: No matched site time and accepted/on-time count.

FSD-CALC-05.unit: seconds difference of published phase means

field_support.conflict_disposition: Retain both; do not select a calibrated success probability.
field_support.paid_labor_saving_missing_reason: Phase means do not identify complete paid support or removable staffing.

hospital_economics.boundary: The three comparisons concern distinct hospitals, services, currencies and methods. Do not average their economics, blend abstract and poster, or correct a published projection into an asserted target result.

rows.boundary: Released task time, not removed paid labor.
rows.label: Active nursing time difference

rows.boundary: Approximate arithmetic agrees with the displayed ratio; does not establish the incremental numerator or reconcile the poster.
rows.label: Program cost / reported released hours

rows.boundary: Modeled strategies, not actual payroll or cash transactions.
rows.label: Annual cost difference

rows.boundary: Annualized manual and simulated robot strategies, distinct from the abstract.

rows.boundary: Cost to release time; no assumption that released time becomes cash savings.
rows.label: Incremental cost / released hours

rows.boundary: Preserve the displayed difference; hidden precision is unknown, and the narrative is retained separately.
rows.label: Table increment minus component arithmetic

rows.boundary: Ten-year projection, not ten years of observed savings.

rows.boundary: Matches the sensitivity total arithmetically; does not identify the authors' implemented cost allocation.

provider_margin.reason: Customer fees do not identify provider resource cost or profit.

target_complete_service_cost.reason: No same-cohort full service, all-actor work and cost ledger.

target_paid_labor_removed.reason: No dated target employment/payroll transition with retained work and complete service.

target_roi.reason: Actual price, transition, financing, staffing, fallback and rights remain unestablished.

target_service_coverage.reason: Selected or assigned tasks do not define every required on-time service.

onboard_timing.missing_reason: Rounded component-sum summary statistics do not identify a full cycle, sustained operation or deadline-miss distribution.

recovery_contracts.boundary: Currencies are separate source presentations, not converted equivalents. Planned hours are not accepted output. Do not repair the headline, invent missing fees, infer title, remaining value, payback or actual payroll savings.
recovery_contracts.legal_boundary: Public documents identify review gates; no target applicability, enforceability, consent or actual termination is determined.

asset_and_finance_residual.reason: No executed finance ownership, purchase option, residual or exit amount is disclosed.

buyer_support_eligibility.reason: No identified robot or buyer entitlement was checked.

control_change_continuity.reason: No target continuation waiver, consent, notice or exercised termination is known.

executed_scope.reason: Target order, incorporated version and written variations are absent.

illustration_reconciliation.reason: The source supplies no explanation connecting the two hourly representations.

whole_service_economics.reason: Accepted output, retained payroll, qualification, downtime and all payer resources are unmeasured.

tac_costs.full_business_cost_missing_reason: Separate environment models, infrastructure, omitted attempts and human work are not fully priced.
